title: 第7章 顿悟突破第8章 真如本性不生不灭
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
持戒堂内，真玄看着真寂盘膝坐下，开始巩固刚刚突破的境界，心中也是一阵感慨。
他本来只是想来跟真寂谈谈，没想到说着说着就变成了点化，更没想到真寂真的顿悟了，而且直接突破了抱丹。
就在这时，一股熟悉的感应忽然从天地间降临，落入他的心神深处。
真玄微微一怔，随即哑然失笑。
天道又给他反馈了。
那股浩瀚而精纯的能量涌入他的丹田，与那颗米粒大小的丹核融为一体。
丹核微微一颤，变得更加凝实、圆润，原本还有些滞涩的真元运转，此刻忽然变得顺畅无比。
抱丹初期，彻底稳固了。
真玄感受着体内真元的变化，心中默默算了一下。
原本他还需要至少半年的时间来稳固境界，现在好了，天道这一波反馈，直接帮他省了半年的时间。
“这算不算无心插柳？”他心中暗想，“本来只是来和真寂聊聊，让他别老盯着自己，结果没想到顺带又无意中装了一次。”
不过话说回来，他看着面前闭目修炼的真寂，心中也有几分触动。
这个平日里看他最不顺眼的人，心里竟然背着这么沉重的包袱。
二十年了，他一个人扛着三个师弟的命，扛着十几个孩子的命，把每一条戒律都守得死死的，生怕再出一点差错。
这人看着黑又硬，内心却如此柔软。
真寂师兄不是刻板，他是真的怕了。
真玄轻轻叹了口气，转身朝门外走去。
推开门扉，夜风扑面而来，带着山中草木的清香。
真恒就站在门外，见他出来，微微一笑。

“做得好。”
真玄摇了摇头：“是他自己的机缘。”
真恒不置可否地笑了笑，目光在真玄身上停留了一瞬，却没有多说什么。
他只是轻轻拍了拍真玄的肩膀。
“走吧，让他好好稳固境界。”
两人并肩朝山下走去，月光将他们的影子拉得很长。
走了几步，真恒忽然开口，声音很轻：“真玄，你还记得当年我带你回寺里的事吗？”
真玄点了点头。
“记得。虽然那时候我才五六岁，但有些事，记得很清楚。”
真恒沉默了片刻，缓缓道：
“你那时候浑身是血，蜷缩在你母亲的怀里。
我把你抱起来的时候，你睁开眼睛看了我一眼，说了几句话，然后又昏了过去。”
“我说了什么？”真玄问。
content_en:
;;
In the Precept Hall, Zhen Xuan watched Zhen Ji sitting down cross-legged and began to consolidate the realm he had just broken through, feeling a burst of emotion in his heart.
He originally just wanted to talk to Zhenji, but he didn't expect that his words would turn into enlightenment, and he didn't expect that Zhenji would really have an epiphany and directly break through the Baodan.
At this moment, a familiar feeling suddenly descended from heaven and earth and fell into the depths of his mind.
Zhenxuan was startled for a moment, then laughed dumbly.
Tiandao gave him feedback again.
The vast and pure energy poured into his Dantian and merged with the rice-sized elixir core.
The core of the pill trembled slightly and became more solid and rounded. The movement of the true energy, which was still a little stagnant, suddenly became extremely smooth at this moment.
In the early stage of holding the elixir, it was completely stable.
Zhenxuan felt the changes in the true energy in his body and silently calculated in his mind.
Originally, he still needed at least half a year to stabilize his realm, but now, this wave of feedback from Tiandao directly saved him half a year.
"Is this unintentional?" He thought to himself, "Originally I just came to chat with Zhenji and asked him to stop staring at me, but I didn't expect that he pretended to be unintentional again."
But having said that, when he looked at Zhen Ji who was practicing with his eyes closed in front of him, he felt a little touched in his heart.
This person who usually disliked him the most was actually carrying such a heavy burden in his heart.
For twenty years, he has been carrying the lives of three junior brothers and more than a dozen children by himself, observing every commandment to the letter, for fear of making another mistake.
This man looks dark and hard, but is so soft on the inside.
Senior Brother Zhenji is not rigid, he is really scared.
Zhenxuan sighed softly, turned and walked towards the door.
Opening the door, the night breeze blows in your face, carrying the fragrance of mountain vegetation.
Zhenheng was standing outside the door and smiled slightly when he saw him coming out.
"Well done."
Zhenxuan shook his head: "It was his own chance."
Zhen Heng smiled noncommittally, his eyes stayed on Zhen Xuan for a moment, but he didn't say anything more.
He just patted Zhenxuan's shoulder lightly.
"Let's go and let him stabilize his realm."
The two walked side by side down the mountain, the moonlight stretching their shadows long.
After walking a few steps, Zhenheng suddenly spoke in a very soft voice: "Zhenxuan, do you still remember when I took you back to the temple?"
Zhenxuan nodded.
"I remember. Although I was only five or six years old at the time, I remember some things very clearly."
Zhenheng was silent for a moment and said slowly:
"You were covered in blood and curled up in your mother's arms.
When I picked you up, you opened your eyes, looked at me, said a few words, and then passed out again. "
"What did I say?" Zhenxuan asked.
